Alice: Quick sync — from INC-847 postmortem we have 5 cross-team action items. Need owner + due date for each. Please ack by EOD PST. Actions:
• A1: implement short-term rate-limit fallback in routing -> owner?
• A2: add prefix caching for customer XYZ -> owner?
• A3: infra to provision extra nodepool for Dedicated -> owner?
• A4: update runbook + canary for model fallback -> owner?
• A5: QA regression test covering batching edge-case -> owner?

Mike: I'll take A1. target 2024-06-28. @Alice will pair w/ me for testing.
Sarah: I'll own A2 but need infra work first. can I set due 2024-07-05? blocked by A3.
Ravi: A3: infra can do nodepool but need capacity request from Eng infra by EOD tomorrow. assigning to @Jordan.
Jordan: ack on A3, filing capacity request ticket ENG-INF-612. Tentative due 2024-06-30.
Mike: noted. If infra misses, can we fallback to burst quota? @Ravi?
Ravi: we can enable burst but needs quota approval. I'll start approval flow now. ETA ~48h.
Sarah: re: A2 — once A3 done, I can finish in 2 days. set due 2024-07-07 to be safe.
Alice: updated list in the postmortem doc: <https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-847|INC-847 RCA>. please add short comment with PR link when ready.
Jordan: created ENG-INF-612 -> https://jira.redwood/browse/ENG-INF-612 : assigned to Jordan, due 2024-06-30.
oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall sync at 15:00 PST today — flag any live-impacting actions.
deploy-bot: Deploy notice: patch for routing fallback scheduled 2024-06-27 03:00 UTC.
Sarah: quick ask — who owns the regression test env? @Mike?
Mike: I'll coordinate test env. ping me earlier for seeds.
Alice: thanks all. I'll compile owners/dates and ping execs tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
